text.tspan: MCP: Connecting Agents to Your Tools and Data
The host runs one MCP client per server; each server exposes tools and resources over JSON-RPC
Host: VS Code, Visual Studio, Copilot CLI, or Claude Code
The agent decides when to call a tool; you decide which servers it may use, which of their tools are on, and what each server can reach
